limitations: The manual side is the user-supplied Laansma passage/table previously structured into a workbook, not a newly performed student review.

Only individually named ROI effects and direction fields shared with the source extraction are paired; aggregate extrema, ICV-adjusted exceptions and MoCA associations are outside this partial denominator.
Percent concordance is field-level extraction agreement, not patient diagnostic accuracy or independent cohort validation.
The demographic store shares the user transcription provenance; its integrity checks are excluded from the independent agreement rate.

The user confirmed human review and research-use approval for the other four papers on 2026-10-03. Paired field values for computing their agreement percentages are not available in this comparison file; no five-paper overall percentage is asserted.
Source discrepancies are retained for inspection; matching does not automatically approve source or segmentation QC.
